messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Control plane 5xx spike detected — elevated 502/504 from config-fanout and auth-proxy. Error rate increased from ~0.3% to 9.7% over the last 3m. Pager sent to oncall. link: https://metrics.redwood.local/d/ctrlplane/5xx-spike
ian (oncall): seeing it — dashboards show org-lookup latency climbing and config service queue depth up. Customers reporting timeouts in onboarding flows.
elaine (sre): logs show repeated upstream 502 from billing-auth at 10.0.2.43 and repeated 429 from config-fanout. Could be a dependency cascade. Collecting traces.
sam (eng-runtime): on the runtime side we're seeing KV cache miss storm on seq < 64 requests, lots of cold starts. Might be correlated with a config push at 09:12 UTC.
jordan (support): we have a ticket from AcmeCorp and two pings in #support-escalations. Can we surface a customer impact note? Mina, fyi.
mina (product): yes please — AcmeCorp says new users can't create projects. Marking P1.
elaine (sre): quick mitigation plan:
- add short-term circuit breaker on config-fanout (reject heavy fanout) to prevent storms
- scale auth-proxy pool + increase connection pool
- roll back the 09:12 config push if it's the cause
ian (oncall): agree. Sam can you toggle cb on the config proxy? If not, we'll scale down fanout via feature flag.
sam (eng-runtime): I can flip a rate-limit at the gateway. Patching now: applying rule to cap fanout concurrency to 6 per request.
deploy-bot: deploy started: config-gateway/rate-limit  -> rollout id d-7342
elaine (sre): running quick curl to check health endpoints:

```
curl -sS https://config-gateway.internal/healthz | jq .
{"uptime":"12d","requests_in_flight":82,"error_rate":0.09}
```

elaine (sre): error_rate reported by gateway still high. After rate-limit rollout, watch for reduction in fanout-related 502s.
ian (oncall): added temporary routing rule to send new org-lookup traffic to secondary cluster (warm standby). Doing a small percentage shift (5%).
sam (eng-runtime): shift applied. Traffic now 95/5 primary/secondary. Observing a ~30% drop in primary CPU and connection saturation.
jordan (support): updating AcmeCorp: "We've applied mitigations and traffic routing to reduce timeouts. Your onboarding should start working intermittently while we mitigate — I'll keep you posted." :white_check_mark:
elaine (sre): digging into traces — many 502s originate from auth-proxy when it tries to hit billing-auth to validate entitlements. Billing-auth is returning 504s after 30s timeouts.
sam (eng-runtime): can we increase billing-auth client timeout and add retries with jitter? that will at least stop long tail blocking.
ian (oncall): can we also temporarily disable synchronous entitlement checks for onboarding flows (fallback to permissive for 5m) while we fix upstream?
mina (product): SLO-wise we can allow permissive for onboarding for 10 minutes. Need to track metrics to revert automatically.
elaine (sre): I created a short runbook action: circuit-break billing-auth after 10 consecutive timeouts and enable permissive fallback for onboarding route. Pushing change.
deploy-bot: config update applied: billing-auth/circuit-breaker=enabled
sam (eng-runtime): added client-side timeout to 5s with 2 retries (exponential backoff) for entitlement calls. Rolling.

```
# envoy filter snippet
- name: upstream-ratelimit
  config:
    max_connections: 6
```

elaine (sre): metrics after 3m: overall 5xx rate down to 2.3%. latency p50 improved. Still seeing some residual errors from one billing datacenter.
ian (oncall): good. Moving to monitoring window. I'll prep a concise incident update for execs and customers.
jordan (support): posting customer note to shared doc and to customers affected with apology + mitigation summary.
mina (product): flagging follow-ups: add a canary step for config pushes, improve fanout safeguards, add auto-fallback for onboarding ent checks.
sam (eng-runtime): creating PRs for retry middleware improvements and more aggressive KV warming for synthetic prefixes.
elaine (sre): action items for postmortem:
- root cause analysis of 09:12 config push and the fanout pattern
- add circuit-breaker thresholds and better fallback for entitlement checks
- enhance alerting to separate dependency-origin 5xx vs internal 5xx
- run chaos / load tests on config-fanout patterns
ian (oncall): handing off to night oncall: @elaine you'll be primary follow-up owner. I'll update rotation and send handoff note in 30m.
elaine (sre): ack. I'll monitor alerts for the next 3h and pick up the follow-ups in the postmortem.
deploy-bot: incident severity set to SEV2 by ia:ian
ian (oncall): closing live mitigation phase. We'll keep watch. If error rate creeps back up to >4% restore escalates to SEV1 and page.
jordan (support): logged customer-impact ticket RED-4021 and linked this thread.
sam (eng-runtime): PRs created: #482 - entitlement-backoff, #483 - fanout-rate-limit
mina (product): thanks team. Good quick coordination. We'll produce a customer-facing timeline after postmortem.
elaine (sre): final note: please attach any logs/traces to the postmortem doc and drop links here. I'll start drafting.
ian (oncall): thx all. handoff complete :handshake:"
